# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.25.0@sha256:0adf442eae370b6087e08edc7c50b552d80ddf261576f4ebd6421006b2461f12
# GENERATED FILE, do not edit. Produced by `tect generate` from
# scripts/Containerfile.skeleton and the example image definition.

ARG BASE
FROM scratch AS ctx
COPY lib/ /lib/
COPY modules/ /modules/
COPY generated/ /generated/

FROM scratch AS tect
COPY out/tect /tect

# ---- BEGIN GENERATED (module layers) ----

### Base Image
FROM ${BASE}

## Module layers

# ---- /opt build root ----
RUN mv /opt /opt.bak && mkdir /opt

# ---- flavour gate ----
ARG FLAVOUR

# ---- image version ----
ARG IMAGE_VERSION=dev

# ---- base family ----
ARG FAMILY

# ---- image identity ----
ARG IMAGE_ID="example"
ARG IMAGE_NAME="Example"
ARG IMAGE_URL="https://github.com/someone/example"
ARG IMAGE_ISSUES_URL="https://github.com/someone/example/issues"
ARG IMAGE_REGISTRY=""

# ---- os-release ----
RUN --mount=type=bind,from=tect,source=/tect,target=/ctx/tect \
    IMAGE_VERSION="${IMAGE_VERSION}" IMAGE_ID="${IMAGE_ID}" IMAGE_NAME="${IMAGE_NAME}" IMAGE_URL="${IMAGE_URL}" IMAGE_ISSUES_URL="${IMAGE_ISSUES_URL}" IMAGE_REGISTRY="${IMAGE_REGISTRY}" /ctx/tect os-release

# ---- finalize ----
RUN --mount=type=bind,from=ctx,source=/generated/example.d/finalize.sh,target=/ctx/finalize.sh \
    --mount=type=bind,from=ctx,source=/lib,target=/ctx/lib \
    --mount=type=bind,from=tect,source=/tect,target=/ctx/tect \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/var/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/var/log \
    --mount=type=tmpfs,target=/tmp \
    FLAVOUR=${FLAVOUR} IMAGE_VERSION="${IMAGE_VERSION}" \
    IMAGE_ID="${IMAGE_ID}" IMAGE_NAME="${IMAGE_NAME}" IMAGE_URL="${IMAGE_URL}" IMAGE_ISSUES_URL="${IMAGE_ISSUES_URL}" IMAGE_REGISTRY="${IMAGE_REGISTRY}" bash /ctx/finalize.sh

# ---- END GENERATED ----

COPY --from=ctx /generated/plan.json /usr/share/tectonic/manifest.json

ARG BASE
ARG BASE_DECLARED=""
ARG TARGET=""
ARG SOURCE_COMMIT=""
ARG MODULE_HASHES=""
ARG ASSET_RESOLUTIONS=""
ARG AUDIT_ENFORCE=""
RUN --mount=type=bind,from=tect,source=/tect,target=/ctx/tect \
    BASE="${BASE}" BASE_DECLARED="${BASE_DECLARED}" TARGET="${TARGET}" \
    SOURCE_COMMIT="${SOURCE_COMMIT}" MODULE_HASHES="${MODULE_HASHES}" \
    ASSET_RESOLUTIONS="${ASSET_RESOLUTIONS}" AUDIT_ENFORCE="${AUDIT_ENFORCE}" \
    IMAGE_ID="${IMAGE_ID}" IMAGE_VERSION="${IMAGE_VERSION}" /ctx/tect build-record

ARG CONTRACT_FILES=""
ARG VERIFY_EXCEPTIONS=""
ARG MODULE_PRESETS=""
RUN --mount=type=tmpfs,target=/run --network=none bootc container lint
RUN --mount=type=bind,from=tect,source=/tect,target=/ctx/tect \
    CONTRACT_FILES="${CONTRACT_FILES}" \
    VERIFY_EXCEPTIONS="${VERIFY_EXCEPTIONS}" \
    MODULE_PRESETS="${MODULE_PRESETS}" \
    FAMILY="${FAMILY}" /ctx/tect validate-image
==== generated/example.d/finalize.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# GENERATED FILE, do not edit.
set -euxo pipefail

# ---- /opt relocation ----
mkdir -p /usr/lib/opt
tmpfiles=/usr/lib/tmpfiles.d/zz-opt-symlinks.conf
printf 'd /var/opt 0755 root root -\n' > "$tmpfiles"
for d in /opt/*/; do
    [ -d "$d" ] || continue
    name="$(basename "$d")"
    cp -a "$d" "/usr/lib/opt/${name}"
    esc="${name// /\\x20}"
    printf 'L+ /var/opt/%s - - - - /usr/lib/opt/%s\n' "$esc" "$esc" >> "$tmpfiles"
done
rm -rf /opt
mv /opt.bak /opt

# ---- module presets ----
apply_module_presets() {
    local scope="$1" dir="$2" flag=() f verb unit
    [ "$scope" = user ] && flag=(--global)
    for f in "$dir"/45-module-*.preset; do
        [ -f "$f" ] || continue
        while read -r verb unit; do
            case "$verb" in
                enable) systemctl "${flag[@]}" enable "$unit" ;;
                disable) systemctl "${flag[@]}" disable "$unit" ;;
                *) ;;
            esac
        done < "$f"
    done
}
apply_module_presets system /usr/lib/systemd/system-preset
apply_module_presets user /usr/lib/systemd/user-preset
==== generated/example.graph.md
# Example capability graph

GENERATED FILE, do not edit.

An arrow points from a provider to what needs it, dotted for `after`,
which orders the build without requiring anything. Layers build left to
right.

```mermaid
graph LR
    base["quay.io/fedora/fedora-bootc:44"]
```

## Capabilities

| Name | Kind | Provided by | Required by | After |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `initramfs-generation` | capability | `base` |  |  |
| `mac-policy` | capability | `base` |  |  |
| `rechunking` | capability | `base` |  |  |
